title: Last Bell, 2019
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The bell. Wood at the motel, day shift for once. A graduating kid's parents check in for the ceremony. He gives them room twelve and a map.

panels.composition: The Driftwood Motel desk, 3:05 PM. The bell, through the glass door, from the school across town. A COUPLE checking in, the mother holding a graduation program.

image.prompt: a motel front desk in daylight with a couple checking in holding a graduation program, a distant bell sound drawn through the glass door, a clerk in a maroon polo, a flat line beneath the panel

panels.composition: The program: SMALL WOOD HIGH SCHOOL · CLASS OF 2019. Wood's eyes on it.

image.prompt: close-up of a graduation program on a motel counter, a clerk's eyes on it

panels.composition: Wood sliding a key and a registration card across. On the card's back: the map. Every building. He does it without deciding to.

characters.pose: sliding a card with a map

image.prompt: a clerk sliding a motel key and a registration card with an intricate hand-drawn town map on its back to a couple
image.notes: Rhymes with dw_2012-08-23. This time: 'Today. I checked.'

panels.composition: The lobby. The couple gone up. The bell done. Wood at the desk. The hum line. Twenty-one years since his own.

image.prompt: a motel lobby with a clerk alone at the desk, a flat line beneath the panel, afternoon light through the glass door, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The map again, current this time. 'Today. I checked.'
